subject: Azure private plan commercial playbook & billing model
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Mercer <marketplace-msft@microsoft.com>, John Patel <john.patel@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Azure private plan commercial playbook & billing model

Hi Sara / John,

Thanks again for the time last week. I’m following up with a focused set of items we need to close to get the private plan listed and set for the joint co-sell motion:

- Attached: RDW_Acme_SOW_draft_v3 + commercial-exhibit-v2 (pricing grid + revenue share examples) and a redline of the Azure private terms we received.
- Primary asks from our side: confirmation of marketplace billing flow for private plans (invoice vs. marketplace charge), expected time-to-list once legal is aligned, and any mandatory marketplace fields that will appear on the Acme invoice.
- Proposed revenue split: 70/30 in favor of Acme for the first 12 months with performance review at month 9 (Marcus will summarize rationale below).

John — I’ve included the draft SOW and an example commercial exhibit so procurement can see the billing cadence and invoicing assumptions. If you prefer to ingest via marketplace billing instead of our direct invoice, call that out and we’ll map the payment terms.

Sara — can you confirm the co-sell registration steps (ISV co-sell form + marketplace acceptance) and whether the private plan SKU can be published before the final contract countersign? Any idiosyncratic Azure fields we need to include for Acme’s finance team?

Next steps: if both procurement and marketplace ops are okay with the billing flow, we’ll move the contracts to legal redlines and schedule a 30-minute sync to lock the commercial exhibit.

Appreciate it —
Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_Acme_SOW_draft_v3.docx (docx), commercial-exhibit-v2.xlsx (xlsx), RDW_AZ_private_terms_redline.pdf (pdf)

From: Sara Mercer <marketplace-msft@microsoft.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, John Patel <john.patel@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Azure private plan commercial playbook & billing model

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the materials — quick clarifying questions before I loop in the marketplace legal team:

1) Billing model: Do you require the marketplace to bill Acme directly (marketplace-charge) or will Redwood invoice Acme and report through the marketplace? Marketplace private plans support both but there are different tax and settlement flows.
2) Revenue share: marketplace legal prefers to see a simple commission table in the commercial exhibit; if you can provide a version with 0/70/100 examples we can expedite.
3) IP/indemnity redlines: I see notes in your PDF. Can Kimberly coordinate with our legal contact for a limited carve on telemetry data and retention?

If you can confirm (1) and send a concise commission table we’ll pull legal and procurement into a shared thread. Tentative earliest listing date after contract sign is ~3 business days for private plans, but that assumes no manual compliance flags.

Cheers,
Sara Mercer
Marketplace Partner Ops — Microsoft
marketplace-msft@microsoft.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan commercial playbook & billing model

Hi all —

I reviewed the RDW_AZ_private_terms_redline.pdf and added counsel’s edits. High-level items to note:

- Indemnity: we proposed retaining Redwood’s standard mutual IP indemnity language; Microsoft legal asked for a broader indemnity tied to partner listing. I redlined a middle-ground clause to limit upstream exposure for telemetry artifacts and third-party data.
- Data retention / telemetry: Kimberly (Legal) suggests the retention period be capped at 90 days for aggregated telemetry used for usage reconciliation; any longer retention requires a customer-facing disclosure in the SOW.
- Marketplace billing: if marketplace-charge is used, make sure the commercial exhibit states "Redwood net settlement subject to Microsoft payout timing" to avoid Acme expecting 7-day payout.
- Termination: added a 30-60 day wind-down clause for any in-flight committed deployments.

I’ve attached the redline PDF. If Sara can share the marketplace legal contact we’ll set a short triage call to resolve the indemnity carve and telemetry language — those are the likely blocking items for procurement.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: RDW_AZ_private_terms_redline.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan commercial playbook & billing model

Thanks everyone — quick summary and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Billing: we’ll aim for marketplace-charge as Marcus suggested. John, please confirm Acme’s treasury is ok with Microsoft settlement timing; if not, we’ll fall back to Redwood-invoice + marketplace reporting.
2) Legal: Kimberly to align with Microsoft legal on the indemnity/telemetry carve. Sara — please introduce your legal contact on the thread.
3) Docs: procurement needs a clean SOW + countersigned commercial exhibit to trigger listing. I’ll upload the final artifacts to the HubSpot deal once countersigned.
4) Call: propose a 30-min triage on Friday 21 May at 10:00am PT to close on the indemnity language and confirm listing mechanics. Agenda: (a) billing flow decision, (b) telemetry retention carve, (c) timeline to list.

If that works for everyone I’ll send a Teams invite and a short agenda. Thanks — leaning on Laura to run the call from our side for co-sell ops.

—
Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com

P.S. Attachments above are draft artifacts; expect one more redline iteration after the legal triage.
